caseNameFull: COOPER Et Al. v. PITCHESS, SHERIFF, LOS ANGELES COUNTY, Et Al.
attorneys: Stanley Fleishman and Sam Rosenwein for appellants., Harold W. Kennedy, William Lamoreaux, William B. McKesson, Ralph F. Bagley and Victor H. Blanch for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon, the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Black are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
